## 2026-11-05 22:43 · claude-macbook · koreanpatch-fabric

Gotcha: MC 26.3 uses SDL3. KeyEvent(key=SDL scancode, keycode=SDL keycode, modifiers=SDL_Keymod raw: shift=3, ctrl=192, alt=768, caps=8192); repeat action is -1 (not 2); CharacterEvent has no modifiers; vanilla has IME preedit (PreeditEvent). On macOS SDL3 never sends Caps Lock from Cocoa_HandleKeyEvent; only SDL3View flagsChanged emits press+release when caps state flips.

## 2026-11-01 17:14 · claude-macbook · mc-motion

Owner design rule (2026-11-01): vanilla silhouette first.
- Never split the 6 boxes: no elbows or knees.
- Avoid realistic RPG-style motion (Better Combat, Epic Fight); it breaks the vanilla feel.
- Rig: 12 joints. Each box rides a joint at its vanilla pivot, hung from a boxless connector 1-2 px inside the torso:
  - chest 1 px above pelvis
  - neck (0,2,0) -> head
  - clavicle (±3,2,0) -> arm
  - hip (±1.9,10,0) -> leg
- Liveliness comes from small pivot motion. Target reaction: "only 6 vanilla boxes, why does it look more alive?"
- The split rig (M0 v1) worked for items, armor, cape and mannequins.
- Known issue from the split rig: the outer 3D skin layer on lower limbs followed the upper box. Moot now; fix if splitting ever returns.

## 2026-10-28 14:02 · claude-macbook · lively-eyes

Release/tooling facts (Lively Eyes):

- **MC skin cache:** MC 26.1 caches skins at `ModrinthApp/meta/assets/skins/<2 chars>/<sha1 of the texture hash as UTF-16LE>` and loads that file instead of downloading. Swap it for a local-only skin test (needs a game restart).
- **Modrinth description images:** only allowlisted hosts load directly (cdn.modrinth.com, imgur, github…); others are proxied via wsrv.nl and often fail. Allowed: `<p align="center">`, `<img>` with width/style (`image-rendering: pixelated`), `<br>`, `<em>`, YouTube iframes.
- **Modrinth drafts:** invisible until moderation approves.
- **Owner preferences:**
  - Emojis only in README headings.
  - The owner removes README sections on purpose; don't re-add them.
  - Talk to the owner in Korean.
- **Hair sway idea (on hold until the owner brings it back):** do it in the bridge mod via `SkinLayersAPI.setupMeshTransformerProvider`. It is applied per render in `CustomizableModelPart.compile`, so you can offset hat-mesh vertices with per-player spring physics, weighted to the back/bottom. Open problems: which entity's hat is being compiled, and chaining with other providers. Rejected alternative: swinging the whole headwear part (moves bangs/hats; FA resets headwear rotation).

## 2026-10-28 14:02 · claude-macbook · lively-eyes

EMF 3.3.11 / MC 26.1.2 gotchas found while building Lively Eyes:

- **invertAxis:** not inherited by submodels. The shared `player_face.jpm` (loaded by player.jem and player_slim.jem) came out un-inverted. Author parts in plain model space with no invertAxis.
- **frame_counter:** stuck in this setup. Time with `age` (ticks + partial tick) instead; skip repeat render passes and GUI previews (`is_in_gui`, `is_first_person_hand`).
- **Parse errors:** one bad expression makes EMF drop the whole model's animations.
- **fluid_depth_up:** an integer count of fluid blocks from the feet block up, not head depth. Head under water = `floor(pos_y) + fluid_depth_up - pos_y - eyeHeight > 0`.
- **nbt():** `nbt(SleepingX,exists:true)` is accepted.
- **pos_y:** interpolated, while blockPos (ETF) is the feet block.
- **FA Player interface:**
  - Inputs, recomputed each frame: `var.idl_headry/rx/rz`.
  - Rendered head readback: `var.head_ry/rx`.
  - FA zeroes headwear rotation each frame.
- **Zoomify:** don't initialize its class from your entrypoint. A lazy `Class.forName(..., false, ...)` on first render avoided a launch crash.
- **Skin Layers 3D:** builds hat voxels inside the head and scales them 1.18x around the head center, so bangs reach z≈-4.72.
